name: HaN-Seg
description: Benchmarks automatic segmentation of head and neck organs-at-risk on CT and MR for radiotherapy planning.
reputation: A recognized benchmark in medical imaging for head-and-neck organs-at-risk segmentation, commonly used in radiotherapy planning research.
notes: Medical-imaging benchmark (non-LLM); performance varies by organ and imaging modality (CT vs MR); subject to inter-observer variability and limited sample sizes for some organs.
